title: Spyglass Tool: Now Generally Available
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of the Spyglass tool, now fully equipped to provide robust insights and empower your operations.

title: Powerful File Controls in Your Editor

summary: We've launched a brand new public roadmap, providing a clear and transparent view of our past accomplishments, current progress, and exciting future plans.

title: Smarter, Sleeker Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a significantly improved checkbox experience with larger, more responsive, and easily draggable checkboxes that seamlessly integrate with our modern interface.

title: Smarter Real-Time Collaboration
summary: Collaborate more effectively than ever before with our refined editor, offering improved clarity and seamless real-time teamwork.

title: Enhanced Collaboration & Shared Content Visibility
summary: We've made it easier than ever to find and collaborate on shared ideas, ensuring all relevant content is visible and accessible across your experience.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out extensive international language capabilities to serve a global audience.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: We're thrilled to open Noeko's codebase, inviting our community to collaborate directly in its development and ensuring maximum transparency and user control.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Transform your knowledge base into an interactive map, allowing you to effortlessly explore, filter, and uncover insights with powerful new tools.

title: Advanced Search & Personalized Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and organize your most relevant information using powerful new search filters, advanced sorting options, and the ability to save your custom curated collections for instant access.

title: Flexible Content Views for Enhanced Notes

title: Noeko: Unlock Enterprise Power, Host Your Way

title: Stunning Themes to Personalize Your Experience

title: Unlock Diverse Content for Deeper Insights
